description: This file defines Express.js routes for session management, including tenant listing, setting active tenant, and toggling super admin mode, with audit logging and RBAC checks.

methods.name: router.get('/tenants')
methods.description: Handles GET request to list authorized tenants for the current user, with audit logging.

methods.name: router.post('/tenant')
methods.description: Handles POST request to set the active tenant for the session, with RBAC validation, cookie setting, and audit logging.

methods.name: router.post('/tenants/select')
methods.description: Alias route to select active tenant, reusing the /tenant handler.

methods.name: router.post('/all-tenants')
methods.description: Handles toggling of super admin mode to disable tenant filters, with audit logging.
